overall_reason: Each country change in the checkout (United States to Germany to Canada) slides the whole address panel sideways on a 900 ms transform with cubic-bezier(0.72, 0, 0.22, 1), and the recorder reports movement still running at 5933 ms; the payment-method value rolls in its own slot, and reduced motion shortens the change to 419 ms.

score.reason: T-SPATIAL-MEANING fails because two countries' address formats are peers, not steps, and T-FREQUENCY fails on 900 ms per change; the rolled select value and the reduced-motion state are the parts that work.

findings.where: passive recording, the address fields under 'Payment method', 1440
findings.evidence: The address panel declares a 900 ms transform on cubic-bezier(0.72, 0, 0.22, 1) on 6 elements; at 2606 ms the old fields slide out to the left ('x Morgan', 'Maple Avenue', 'rtland') while the next set ('Nar', 'Stre', 'Pos') enters from the card's right edge.
findings.before: Changing the country slides the whole address panel sideways like a page.
findings.after: Keep the shared fields in place, move only the fields that differ, and crossfade the changed labels (MOT-273).
findings.why: A sideways slide says 'next step', but the buyer only changed country, so their filled-in fields seem to leave.
findings.root: the 900 ms transform on the address panel

findings.where: passive recording, the address panel transition, 1440
findings.evidence: The transform lasts 900 ms, and the recorder reports the composition still moving at 5933 ms of a 6000 ms window.
findings.before: 900 ms of sideways movement per country change.
findings.after: Treat the change as feedback: under about 250 ms on an ease-out curve.
findings.why: A buyer comparing prices may switch country several times, and each switch waits on the form.

strengths: The payment-method value rolls inside its own select ('Bank transfer' half-risen at 2606 ms) instead of swapping in one frame (MOT-253).
Under reduced motion the change completes in 419 ms instead of sliding.
not_investigated: two stills (11307 and 11345 ms) fall outside the 6 s recording, so the Canada change is seen only as an end state
